page_summary: This page discusses the systemic risks in ports due to the integration of IT and OT systems, highlighting the vulnerabilities and challenges posed by cyber incidents. It emphasizes the increasing interconnection of systems and the impact of human factors on cybersecurity. The text also mentions the rise in reported incidents affecting maritime OT systems and the role of geopolitical tensions in cyber threats.

regions.description: Main text discussing systemic risks, integration of IT and OT, and the rise of cyber incidents in ports.

regions.description: Illustrates recent examples of cyber incidents in the maritime transport sector.
